international.canonicalTopic: ISRO-European Space Agency cooperation agreement extension
international.headline: ISRO and ESA extend space-cooperation agreement until 2032
facts: ISRO and the European Space Agency extended their cooperation agreement until January 8, 2032.
The extension was formalised through an exchange of letters at the International Space Summit in Paris on September 10, 2026.
The original agreement came into force in January 2002.
The renewed framework covers human and robotic space exploration, space weather and sustainable outer-space activities.
ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan and ESA Director General Josef Aschbacher signed the extension documents.
international.summary: The renewed ISRO-ESA framework continues bilateral space cooperation through January 2032 across exploration and related fields.
international.staticLink: ESA is an intergovernmental space organisation headquartered in Paris, France.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The extended agreement expires on January 8, 2032; it was formalised in Paris on September 10, 2026.
international.mainsAngle: Long-term international frameworks enable cooperation in space exploration, space-weather research and sustainable use of outer space.

national.headline: ICAR and ICRISAT convene Global Dryland Congress in New Delhi
facts: The Global Dryland Congress–2026 was held in New Delhi from September 10–12, 2026, under the theme “Transforming Dryland Agriculture with South-South Cooperation.”
ICAR and the International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics (ICRISAT) jointly organised the congress, marking 50 years of their partnership.
More than 800 scientists, policymakers, farmers and development partners participated.
The notes state that drylands cover around 45% of the world’s land area and support the livelihoods of more than two billion people.
ICRISAT is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, and focuses on agricultural research for dryland and semi-arid regions.
national.summary: The congress brought together stakeholders to discuss dryland agriculture and South-South cooperation.
national.staticLink: ICAR coordinates agricultural research and education in India; ICRISAT is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The congress was jointly organised by ICAR and ICRISAT in New Delhi.
national.mainsAngle: Assess the importance of climate-resilient agricultural research and cooperation for dryland communities.

national.canonicalTopic: Tanya Chaudhary and Nirbhay Chaudhary hammer throw marks
national.headline: Tanya Chaudhary and Nirbhay Chaudhary record national hammer-throw marks
facts: At the Indian Athletics Series Final at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi, on September 10, 2026, Tanya Chaudhary threw 68.35 metres and Nirbhay Chaudhary threw 71.02 metres.
The notes compare Nirbhay’s mark with Neeraj Kumar’s 70.73 metres, set in 2016, and Tanya’s with Anushka Yadav’s 67.02 metres, set in June 2026.
national.summary: Tanya Chaudhary and Nirbhay Chaudhary produced the stated women’s and men’s hammer-throw marks at the Indian Athletics Series Final.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The marks recorded were 68.35 metres for Tanya Chaudhary and 71.02 metres for Nirbhay Chaudhary.
national.mainsAngle: Athletics performance highlights the role of competitive opportunities and sports infrastructure in developing talent.

national.canonicalTopic: IIT Ropar Army Air Defence College MTech agreement
national.headline: IIT Ropar and Army Air Defence College agree on Defence Technology M.Tech
facts: IIT Ropar and the Army Air Defence College, Gopalpur, Odisha, signed an agreement on September 10, 2026, to provide M.Tech education in Defence Technology to Indian Army officers.
The course is intended to give academic recognition to professional training undertaken by officers on the Long Air Defence Course.
The agreement was signed by IIT Ropar Director Professor Rajeev Ahuja and Army Air Defence College Commandant Lieutenant General Amit Rao.
national.summary: The agreement links Army air-defence professional training with postgraduate education at IIT Ropar.
national.staticLink: Army Air Defence College and higher technical education
national.prelimsTakeaway: The Army Air Defence College is located in Gopalpur, Odisha, as stated in the notes.
national.mainsAngle: Formal recognition of professional training can strengthen specialised human-resource development in defence.
